items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: You all didn't get in touch with David Jones in California.

ctx.x: He played trombone too, didn't he?

I think he was a biotone. But he was... No honest... But I... Did he play trombone too? I didn't know. He played trombone. I think somebody told me... But I know he was one of the... They said he was one of the greatest biotone players. He was. Zilp had a miss. And you didn't meet... You all didn't get in touch with David Jones in California. No, we missed him.
